events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI assistant, not a person. I act as the IT helpdesk agent for Halcyon Components' service desk. I don't know which underlying AI model powers me.

I can reset employee passwords and look up support tickets. If you'd rather speak with a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

If you'd like to continue, send me your employee ID. I'll send the reset link to the phone registered on your account.
